Definition: from the same as G639; a (state of) quandary:--perplexity.
BiblicalUsage: A single use, and the whole earth is at a loss: upon the earth there shall be distress of nations, with perplexity — the sea and the waves roaring — the word is a quandary with no way out, a whole world at a loss.
TheologicalSignificance: The perplexity belongs to the nations, not the disciples: the world will not know the way out, but those who watch will.
